program_name: Bachelor of Computer Science (Hons) (Mobile Development) (Dual-Award Degree)

fees.notes: The programme is now offered as BSc (Hons) Computer Science major in Mobile Computing with Coventry University; the current official INTI page (https://newinti.edu.my/programme/bachelor-of-computer-science-hons-in-network-and-mobile-computing-coventry-uk/, checked 2026-09-18) lists the international approximate tuition as RM85,848. Fees are exclusive of SST; a 6% SST applies to international students' fees.
